auth_details: JWT via OAuth then GET https://www.inaturalist.org/users/api_token; send Authorization: Bearer <JWT> (24h expiry). Required for PUT/POST and some private GETs; many reads work unauthenticated. Does not grant a documented higher rate limit.
rate_limits: Official guidance: ~1 request/second and ~10,000/day (Recommended Practices); swagger Terms also cite max ~100/min (prefer ≤60/min) and 10k/day. Excess may get HTTP 429; media downloads have separate caps. Auth has no documented higher quota.
resolution_notes: auth: Auditor right on purpose and no higher-rate tier; Bearer is the supported form. Swagger (https://api.inaturalist.org/v1/swagger.json) says JWT for PUT/POST and private GETs only—no rate-tier claim. Recommended Practices (https://www.inaturalist.org/pages/api+recommended+practices) says authenticate only when required (auth responses uncached). auth_type jwt stands. rate_limits: Auditor right. Same Recommended Practices (rev. 2025-02-27): ~1/s and ~10k/day, HTTP 429, media caps; no auth higher tier. Swagger Terms still list max ~100/min, prefer ≤60/min, under 10k/day. Original’s “no published quotas” and community ~100 unauth/~1000 auth claims are wrong.
